 Disney child star, 14, supported by co-stars on hit show following mother's death
 Fran Winston Updated 2026년 10월 25일 일 오전 7:32 UTC 0 High Potential child star Matthew Lamb has announced his mother has died (Image: Getty) High Potential star Matthew Lamb, 14, has been flooded with support from his co-stars on the show, which airs on Disney+ in the UK, following the death of his mother Merideth on Saturday October 17. The teenager, who has played Elliot Radovic, the son of Kaitlin Olson's Morgan Gillroy , since the show began in 2024 confirmed his mum's death in an emotional Instagram post. Alongside a carousel of pictures of the pair in happier times he penned: "I'm not quite sure how to write this. As I'm sure many of you know, my mama passed away this Saturday. She was everything to me. She taught me school, she taught me empathy, she did everything for our family.
 "She always had the biggest smile and she gave the best hugs. Truly the most selfless person I know.
 "It still doesn't feel real. I'm not sure it ever will. She loved and supported everyone authentically. I'm not sure how we're going to get through this, but we're going to try.
 "Every day I'm going to miss telling her about my day, and talking to her and watching our favorite shows.
 "This isn't something I ever thought I would have to do. There's so much she is going to miss in my life, but I'm grateful for the things she was able to experience."
 He concluded the heartbreaking post simply writing: "I love you, Mama."
 Matthew Lamb shared a heartbreaking tribute to his mother following her death (Image: matthewlambofficialinstagram) His co-stars were quick to offer him their support with on-screen mother Kaitlin leading the tributes commenting on his post and promising to be there for him.
 "Your mama was such a gift, Matthew. She simply overflowed with joy and kindness...and the way she lit up when she looked at you....that can't ever be taken away. You are forever her pride and joy. I am here for you forever," she promised.
 Judy Reyes, who plays Lieutenant Selena Soto shared: "We saw where you got your shine! I'm so so sorry."
 Fellow child star Charlotte Ann Tucker, who guest starred in the show as Ellie Ashford reflected: "I am heartbroken. She was such a kind and beautiful person and everyone who knew her loved her. We were blessed to be able to meet your amazing family. We are sending so much love and prayers."
 High Potential child star Matthew Lamb is being suported by his co-stars, including Kaitlin Olsen (Image: Getty) Skywalker Hughes, who plays Mary Ingalls in Netflix 's adaptation of Little House on the Prairie, also shared her condolences.
 "Matthew, we're are so incredibly sorry. We had the chance to fall in love with your sweet momma. We are so sorry to hear. It was truly impossible not to love your sweet momma and she loved so genuinely and was full of kindness. She loved you so incredibly much. She is SO proud of you. She was light and love. Sending so much love to you and your family. Skywalker and Christina."
 Wicked for Good star Scarlett Spears who played Young Glinda, the child version of Ariana Grande's character, in the hit movie, also offered her sympathies.
 "Matthew, Scarlett and I just met you and your beautiful mom just a few weeks ago. We sat, we chatted, we giggled, and hoped to see one another again soon.. I'm so deeply sorry for this... no words will adequately make this hurt any less. Just know you have a lot of people who will be here for you, and step up when you need us. I'm grateful we got to meet her.. I'm grateful we got to see her beautiful heart, and experience her kindness, even for a brief moment. I'll be praying for you... now and always. She is SO proud of you... always will be. My heart goes out to you all..." she said.
